title: [Riso] Location Course duration field - Config ON displays optional field and saves value
description: LT-98511 AC-01.1/01.2/01.4 - Configuration + CRUD - Riso users can enter Location Duration on Location Course and reload the saved value.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ/Admin user in Riso Salesforce org. Lesson custom setting config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Location Course Riso LC Duration A exists and user has edit access.
steps_actions: 1. Open Location Course Riso LC Duration A detail page. 2. Inspect the Information section or edit form. 3. Enter Location Duration = 50 and save. 4. Refresh or reopen the Location Course record. 5. Inspect the saved Location Duration field.
steps_result: 1. Location Course detail page opens. 2. Location Duration field is displayed and is not marked required. 3. Save succeeds without validation unrelated to duration. 4. Record reloads successfully. 5. Location Duration shows 50 and can be retrieved by lesson creation lookup.
steps_data: 1. config = ON. 2. field = Location_Duration__c; required = false. 3. value = 50. 4. action = reload. 5. expected = 50.

title: [Riso] Location Course duration field - Blank default remains blank
description: LT-98511 AC-01.2/01.3 - Default/Negative - Location Duration is optional and remains blank when no value is entered.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ/Admin user in Riso Salesforce org. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Course Master and Location exist for a new Location Course.
steps_actions: 1. Create or open Location Course Riso LC Blank Duration B. 2. Leave Location Duration blank and save. 3. Reopen the Location Course detail page. 4. Open the edit form again.
steps_result: 1. Location Course form opens with Location Duration available. 2. Save succeeds with blank Location Duration. 3. Location Duration displays blank or --, not 0. 4. Field remains blank and optional; no default value is injected.
steps_data: 1. config = ON. 2. Location_Duration__c = blank. 3. expected persisted blank. 4. required = false.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - Location Course duration overrides 80-minute timeslot
description: LT-98511 AC-02.1/02.2 - Decision Table - A Location Course duration takes priority over the selected timeslot duration.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Timeslot 1 exists from 09:00 to 10:20. Location Course Course A exists at selected location with Location Duration = 50.
steps_actions: 1. Open New Lesson from Salesforce Lesson Calendar or Lesson tab. 2. Select lesson date and Timeslot 1. 3. Select Location Course Course A. 4. Inspect Duration, Start Time, and End Time. 5. Save the lesson with required fields completed. 6. Reopen the created lesson detail.
steps_result: 1. New Lesson form opens. 2. Start Time = 09:00, End Time = 10:20, Duration initially reflects timeslot or waits for course selection. 3. Course A is selected. 4. Duration updates to 50; Start Time remains 09:00; End Time recalculates to 09:50. 5. Lesson saves successfully. 6. Lesson detail stores Duration = 50 and time range 09:00-09:50.
steps_data: 1. config = ON. 2. timeslot = 09:00-10:20, 80 mins. 3. course duration = 50. 4. expected duration = 50; expected end = 09:50. 5. action = save. 6. persisted duration = 50.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - Blank Location Course duration falls back to timeslot
description: LT-98511 AC-02.1/02.3 - Decision Table - When the selected Location Course has blank duration, lesson Duration uses the selected timeslot.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Timeslot 1 exists from 09:00 to 10:20. Location Course Course B exists at selected location with Location Duration blank.
steps_actions: 1. Open New Lesson form. 2. Select Timeslot 1. 3. Select Location Course Course B. 4. Inspect Duration, Start Time, and End Time. 5. Save and reopen the lesson.
steps_result: 1. New Lesson form opens. 2. Start Time = 09:00, End Time = 10:20, Duration = 80. 3. Course B is selected and has no course duration. 4. Duration remains 80; Start Time remains 09:00; End Time remains 10:20. 5. Saved lesson keeps Duration = 80 and time range 09:00-10:20.
steps_data: 1. config = ON. 2. timeslot duration = 80. 3. course duration = blank. 4. expected duration = 80. 5. persisted duration = 80.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - No course duration and no timeslot keeps existing default/manual behavior
description: LT-98511 AC-02.4 - Negative/Regression - Without Location Course duration and without Timeslot, the form does not force a course-derived duration.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Location Course Course B has Location Duration blank. Timeslot is optional/available but not selected.
steps_actions: 1. Open New Lesson form without selecting Timeslot. 2. Select Location Course Course B. 3. Inspect Duration, Start Time, and End Time. 4. Manually enter Start Time = 13:00 and Duration = 45. 5. Inspect End Time.
steps_result: 1. New Lesson form opens. 2. Course B is selected and has blank duration. 3. Duration follows existing default behavior or remains available for manual entry; no 0 or stale course value is forced. 4. Manual values are accepted. 5. End Time recalculates to 13:45 according to existing duration behavior.
steps_data: 1. timeslot = none. 2. course duration = blank. 3. expected = existing default/manual behavior. 4. start = 13:00; duration = 45. 5. expected end = 13:45.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - Manual Duration Start Time and End Time edits are retained until source change
description: LT-98511 AC-03.1/03.2/03.3/03.4 - State Retention - Staff can manually override time fields and the values remain while source fields are unchanged.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Timeslot 1 = 09:00-10:20. Course A Location Duration = 50.
steps_actions: 1. Open New Lesson form. 2. Select Timeslot 1 and Course A. 3. Manually change Duration to 55. 4. Manually change Start Time to 09:10. 5. Manually change End Time to 10:00. 6. Edit another non-source field such as Lesson Name or Teaching Medium.
steps_result: 1. Duration is initially 50 and End Time is 09:50 after Course A is selected. 2. Source values are selected. 3. Duration field accepts 55 and updates dependent time according to existing rules. 4. Start Time accepts 09:10. 5. End Time accepts 10:00. 6. Duration, Start Time, and End Time remain at the manually entered values because Timeslot and Location Course were not changed.
steps_data: 1. source = Timeslot 1 + Course A. 2. expected duration = 50. 3. manual duration = 55. 4. manual start = 09:10. 5. manual end = 10:00. 6. non-source change = Lesson Name.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - Timeslot change recalculates after manual override
description: LT-98511 AC-04.1/04.2 - State Transition - Changing Timeslot after manual edits recalculates from the latest source values and does not keep stale manual duration.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Course B has blank Location Duration. Timeslot 1 = 09:00-10:20. Timeslot 2 = 11:00-12:20.
steps_actions: 1. Open New Lesson form. 2. Select Course B and Timeslot 1. 3. Manually change Duration to 45 and verify the form accepts it. 4. Change Timeslot from Timeslot 1 to Timeslot 2. 5. Inspect Duration, Start Time, and End Time.
steps_result: 1. New Lesson form opens. 2. Duration = 80 from Timeslot 1 because Course B duration is blank. 3. Duration temporarily becomes 45 and dependent time updates according to existing rules. 4. Timeslot 2 is selected as the latest source. 5. Manual 45 is overwritten; Duration recalculates to 80; Start Time = 11:00; End Time = 12:20.
steps_data: 1. course duration = blank. 2. timeslot1 = 09:00-10:20. 3. manual duration = 45. 4. timeslot2 = 11:00-12:20. 5. expected duration = 80.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - Location Course change recalculates and config OFF preserves old behavior
description: LT-98511 AC-04.1/04.3 + Config Scope - Changing Location Course after manual edits recalculates from the new course; disabling config hides the feature and preserves timeslot behavior.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org. Course A Location Duration = 50. Course C Location Duration = 60. Timeslot 1 = 09:00-10:20. A separate non-Riso or config-OFF org/user fixture is available.
steps_actions: 1. With config ON, open New Lesson form. 2. Select Timeslot 1 and Course A. 3. Manually change Duration to 45. 4. Change Location Course from Course A to Course C. 5. Inspect Duration, Start Time, and End Time. 6. In a config-OFF/non-Riso fixture, open Location Course and New Lesson form with the same timeslot/course data.
steps_result: 1. New Lesson form opens with Location Course duration feature enabled. 2. Duration = 50 and End Time = 09:50. 3. Duration temporarily becomes 45. 4. Course C is selected as the latest source. 5. Manual 45 is overwritten; Duration recalculates to 60; Start Time remains 09:00; End Time recalculates to 10:00. 6. Location Duration field/override behavior is hidden or inactive; lesson duration follows existing timeslot behavior and does not use course duration override.
steps_data: 1. config = ON. 2. Course A duration = 50. 3. manual duration = 45. 4. Course C duration = 60. 5. expected duration = 60; expected end = 10:00. 6. config = OFF; expected duration = timeslot 80.

title: [Riso] Lesson creation - Tenant without Timeslot feature still applies Location Course duration
description: LT-98511 AC-02.1/02.4 + no-timeslot feature regression - Tenant/org flows that do not use Timeslot still apply Location Course duration from the selected course and keep manual/default behavior when course duration is blank.
preconditions: Logged in as center staff in Riso Salesforce org or fixture where Timeslot feature is disabled/not used in lesson creation. config_Lesson_Location_Lesson_Duration__c = true. Course A Location Duration = 50. Course B Location Duration blank.
steps_actions: 1. Open New Lesson form in the no-timeslot tenant/org flow. 2. Enter Start Time = 09:00. 3. Select Location Course Course A with Location Duration = 50. 4. Inspect Duration and End Time. 5. Change Location Course to Course B with blank Location Duration. 6. Manually enter Duration = 45 and inspect End Time. 7. Save and reopen the lesson.
steps_result: 1. New Lesson form opens without requiring or displaying a Timeslot selection as the duration source. 2. Start Time is accepted. 3. Course A is selected. 4. Duration updates to 50 and End Time recalculates to 09:50 even though no Timeslot is used. 5. Course B is selected and blank course duration does not force 0 or stale 50. 6. Manual Duration = 45 is accepted and End Time recalculates to 09:45. 7. Saved lesson persists the manually confirmed duration/time values without Timeslot dependency.
steps_data: 1. tenant timeslot feature = disabled/not used. 2. start = 09:00. 3. Course A duration = 50. 4. expected end = 09:50. 5. Course B duration = blank. 6. manual duration = 45; expected end = 09:45. 7. action = save/reopen.
